name: read
description: Read UTF-8 files and obtain the revision needed for write overwrites. path accepts one path string or an array of up to 32 paths. offset is a 1-based line number; limit defaults to 200 (max 500). Follow nextOffset until absent for a complete read. Pass the returned revision as write.expectedRevision, not as a field named revision.

anyOf.description: VFS path: ~ is /home/user; relative paths use this agent's cwd. Paths are case-sensitive.

items.description: VFS path: ~ is /home/user; relative paths use this agent's cwd. Paths are case-sensitive.

offset.description: Starting line, 1-based; default 1. Continue with the previous result's nextOffset.

limit.description: Maximum lines per file; default 200, max 500. Follow nextOffset when present.
